notes.title: 5 days to release!
notes.notes:
5 days until we release! Aghh! So exciting!



We're putting the final touches to the game. Polish. Polish. Polish.



Our programmer is finessing, tweaking and lightly perspiring.

Our QA tester is poking and prodding the last few bugs.

Our marketing team is putting together a visual feast for the eyes!

 

Our art department are on the beach. They finished their work months ago...  



Speaking of marketing - here's a new screenshot! It's the Drawing Room with all our UI. Our current screenshots are a little old, so we're doing a light refresh. 



What do you think? I like the birdie.



Polish. Polish. Polish. See you in 5 days!
